title: [Bug]: AMF crash in common_register_state due to stale ran_ue_id after Handoverrequired and duplicate IMSI registration

labels.name: Housekeeping:ToClose
labels.description: Issues reviewed and closed. Old requests, issues which are not bug, feature or documentation request

body:
### Open5GS Release, Revision, or Tag

v2.7.3

### Steps to reproduce

1. Process one: Handover required

- Deploy two GNBS, each configured with a different IP address, and use different IMSI to connect two different terminals.

- There is an executable but incomplete handover required message

- The original gNB-UE context will be released

[Problematic handover required process.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19863206/Problematic.handover.required.process.zip)


2. Process two: The loop of the initial process

- Configure a new UE (IMSI matching one from Step 1) to connect via a third gNB.

- The third UE repeatedly executes the processes such as initial registration, authentication, PDU session establishment, release, etc.


[Repeated imsi registration authentication pdu session establishment and release cycle process.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19863205/Repeated.imsi.registration.authentication.pdu.session.establishment.and.release.cycle.process.zip)

First, perform Process one, which will trigger the incomplete switching of the two gNBs requirements and create two additional gNB-UE contexts. Then before the release of the first two gNBS, start to repeat Process two multiple times. Observe the crash of AMF until the gNB of Process one is released.

We suspect that there is a conflict between the imsi of Process One and Process two. Therefore, when process Two is executed, the gnb in Process One is released, resulting in the release of the context of Process Two as well. Thus, the problem of not being able to find the ran_ue value occurs.




### Logs

```shell
[gmm] INFO: UE SUPI[imsi-460110000000001] DNN[ctnet] S_NSSAI[SST:1 SD:0x111111] smContextRef[NULL] smContextResourceURI[NULL] (../src/amf/gmm-handler.c:1374)
[amf] INFO: [5ad00c9a-2008-41f0-a94d-775d728e2504] Setup NF Instance [type:SMF] (../src/amf/context.c:2429)
[gmm] INFO: SMF Instance [5ad00c9a-2008-41f0-a94d-775d728e2504] (../src/amf/gmm-handler.c:1415)
[amf] INFO: Setup NF EndPoint(addr) [127.0.0.4:7777] (../src/amf/nsmf-handler.c:144)
[amf] INFO: [imsi-460110000000001:1:11][0:0:NULL] /nsmf-pdusession/v1/sm-contexts/{smContextRef}/modify (../src/amf/nsmf-handler.c:942)
[amf] INFO: gNB-N2[10.170.7.204] connection refused!!! (../src/amf/amf-sm.c:873)
[amf] INFO: [Removed] Number of gNBs is now 2 (../src/amf/context.c:1301)
[amf] INFO: [Removed] Number of gNB-UEs is now 2 (../src/amf/context.c:2792)
[amf] INFO: [imsi-460110000000002:1:51][0:0:NULL] /nsmf-pdusession/v1/sm-contexts/{smContextRef}/modify (../src/amf/nsmf-handler.c:942)
[amf] INFO: [Removed] Number of gNB-UEs is now 1 (../src/amf/context.c:2792)
[amf] INFO: [imsi-460110000000001:1:51][0:0:NULL] /nsmf-pdusession/v1/sm-contexts/{smContextRef}/modify (../src/amf/nsmf-handler.c:942)
[gmm] FATAL: common_register_state: Assertion `ran_ue' failed. (../src/amf/gmm-sm.c:1315)
[core] FATAL: backtrace() returned 10 addresses (../lib/core/ogs-abort.c:37)
```

### Expected behaviour

When a new UE with a duplicate IMSI registers, AMF should either reject the request or safely manage context conflicts without crashing.

### Observed Behaviour

- After releasing original gNB-UE contexts, AMF retains amf_ue->ran_ue_id pointers to deleted ran_ue objects.

- During subsequent registration attempts (with duplicate IMSI), AMF triggers ogs_assert(ran_ue) in common_register_state() because ran_ue_find_by_id() returns NULL.

### eNodeB/gNodeB

_No response_
